entry.title: A Robotic Hand on the Crawl

media:group.media:title: A Robotic Hand on the Crawl
media:group.media:description:
Just in time for Halloween, things get spooky at ETH Zurich: A robotic hand crawls along on its own – without a body. What looks like something straight out of a ghost movie is actually the result of innovative robotics research.
Video: Nicole Davidson / ETH Zürich
A special thank you to ROOM Escape Room for letting us film at their location!

entry.title: Meet femtoG: A New Approach to Particle and Powder Analysis

media:group.media:title: Meet femtoG: A New Approach to Particle and Powder Analysis
media:group.media:description:
Discover femtoG, an ETH Zurich spin-off based in Switzerland, pioneering innovative technology for particle mass and powder characterization. Its advanced analyzers help industries better understand particle size, mass, and structure, enabling smarter quality control and process optimization.

media:group.media:title: Autonomous Bike: ETH Students Rethink Bike Sharing
media:group.media:description:
Mechanical engineering students built an autonomous bike as part of a one-year Bachelor’s degree project. The AutoBike has the potential to help bike-sharing companies with bike redistribution in the future. This project gave the students the opportunity to develop the technology from concept to prototype.
